premises.text: Clients expect personalized portfolios and advice, but advisors lack time and tools and dump clients into generic funds
premises.evidence_span: Clients expect personalized portfolios tailored to their needs, but instead are getting dumped into generic buckets of mutual funds and ETFs

premises.text: AI builds personalized portfolios around clients' goals, values, risk, and constraints using quant and machine-learning models
premises.evidence_span: build personalized portfolios around their clients' values, goals, and dreams

premises.text: Portfolio intelligence explains investment decisions so advisors can tell clients the why behind the portfolio
premises.evidence_span: we provide the portfolio intelligence for them to be able to explain those investment decisions and the why behind their portfolio to the clients

premises.text: Automation of management and rebalancing frees advisors to focus on trusted client relationships
premises.evidence_span: VisAI automates all of the management, rebalancing, and everything

premises.text: Distribution via financial-institution and Riskalyze partnerships reaches advisors at a low AUM fee
premises.evidence_span: partnered with Fortune 100 financial institutions and a successful trailblazer in space, Riskalyze, to give us a distribution advantage

value.text: Personalized, explainable portfolios that help advisors deliver better client outcomes while keeping relationships central
value.evidence_span: advisors can focus their time on what they do best, building great client relationships
